dogecoin.text: So many people livestreaming or live blogging SNL together with DOGE coin price on YouTube/Twitter, what an interesting time to be alive!

@elonmusk Musk spending zero advertising dollars attracting all dogecoiners to Tesla  is genius. Ford spends over 2 billion on advertising annually in the US alone. That is an extra $2 bln in gross margin for Tesla. And in the long run dogecoin likely outperform Fiat.
